# Hunter's Handbook data (vendored)

`BestiaryData.lua` and `Data.lua` (its training guide: rank levels, costs, families) are copied unchanged from [Hunter's Handbook](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/hunters-handbook) 1.0.15 by Wood, licensed GPLv3. It's kept here so `tools/build_bestiary.py` can rebuild `Handbook.lua` and `Training.lua` without downloading anything.

It is not loaded by the addon. To update it, download a newer Hunter's Handbook release and replace these files.
